newsitem.title: USA: CME FEEDER CATTLE RALLY SHARPLY ON SHORT COVERING.
newsitem.headline: CME FEEDER CATTLE RALLY SHARPLY ON SHORT COVERING.

text.p: Active short covering developed in CME feeder cattle futures and prices ran up for fairly large gains, traders said.
Corn futures did not open as high as expected and feeder cattle futures were down to levels that sparked buying interest. Some buy stops added to advance prices after a mostly lower start, they said.
Feeders were up 0.775 to 0.525 cent per lb with August up most at 80.200 cents.
